body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Design: the updater only ever applies a VERIFIED bundle (remote or local cache). When neither is available it writes nothing (no DB, no cache), logs a warning saying whether existing rows were kept, and returns {updated:false, skipped:'no-signed-manifest'|'unavailable', reason}. The empty-placeholder path (_writeEmptyPlaceholder, version '0') is removed. The list-file-missing branch now sets remoteFetchError so the reason is filled. getStatus() keeps version:null / lastFetchedAt:null until the first success and adds in-memory lastCheckedAt / lastCheckError (also remoteError when a cache fallback masked a remote failure). Installs already wiped (meta '0') recover on the next verified fetch; no migration. Existing behavior kept: hash-mismatch abort without cache fallback, version-inequality compare, _applySignedTier, verified empty lists still apply.

Sub-tasks:
- [sub-task 1] Tests first: checkForUpdates failure handling (fetch stub, tmp data dir, ed25519-signed fixtures; 11 cases, expected red until impl) (standard)
- [sub-task 2] Implement in global-site-blocklist-updater.js (+ server.js status fallbacks) (standard) — after 1
- [sub-task 3] CHANGELOG Fixed entry (light)
- [sub-task 4] Verification: suite, greps, Node-harness offline smoke on a temp data dir (two separate processes; no daemon; no browser tools) (standard) — last

DOCS phase acceptance: SITE_POLICY.md failure-modes row and Known-gaps row, CONTRIBUTING.md fallback sentence, MCP_SERVER.md/MCP_INTEGRATION.md mentions. Out of scope: shipping a blocklist snapshot with the installer (separate ticket).
